name: Peelwick
subtitle: Cut out, erase & make stickers
shortDescription: Remove background from photos on your phone, then save a transparent PNG or make sticker packs.
longDescription:
Remove background from photos on your phone, then erase or restore with brushes, soften edges, add a colour, gradient or scene, and save a transparent PNG.

### Stickers
Make sticker packs (512 x 512 WebP) for WhatsApp.

### Private
Photos never leave your device.

Free to start with 2 credits, earn more by watching a short ad, or go ad-free with a monthly plan.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
